markup.name: buildingSMART BCF-XML 2.1 Markup (`markup.bcf` per topic, plus the container-level `bcf.version`) -- topic and comment text, version, plus the whole-document set-snapshot/no-mutation surface. The shared reader/writer for the whole BCF-ZIP container lives here; the other two subsets reuse it (family-module pattern) rather than duplicating it.

viewpoint.name: buildingSMART BCF-XML 2.1 Viewpoint (`viewpoint.bcfv` per topic) -- camera and visibility/coloring component state, a file distinct from that topic's markup.

snapshot.name: buildingSMART BCF-XML 2.1 Snapshot (`snapshot.png` per topic) -- the screen-capture image file, distinct from that topic's markup and viewpoint.
